procedure.title: Rewrite Inline Script Tag (ES6+)
procedure.step: Identify the inline <script> block in the Blade template. Note the page/route it belongs to.
Convert all var → const/let. Use const by default; let only when reassigned.
Convert function expressions and callbacks to arrow functions.
Replace string concatenation with template literals.
Add event-listener guards (dataset check) for every addEventListener call.
Replace boilerplate functions with guard.* singleton calls.
If the script exceeds ~30 lines, extract to an external .js file loaded with defer.

procedure.title: Route Verification
procedure.step: Determine the expected pathname for this page (e.g., "/admin/tasks").

Add a guard at the start of the IIFE body:
if (!window.location.pathname.startsWith("/admin/tasks")) return;
This prevents the script from executing on unrelated pages when Blade caching or Turbolinks is active.

procedure.title: Toast / Alert Fallback
procedure.step:
Check if the singleton toast system is available:
const toast = window.erpGuard?.showToast;

procedure.title: Translation Dictionary Setup
procedure.step:
In the Blade template (or a shared partial), render the translation dictionary from PHP:
<script> window.translations = @json($translations); </script>
Replace /* context-specific key */ with the actual translation key for the field or action (e.g., "task.name.required").

procedure.title: MutationObserver Listener Cleanup
procedure.step: Inside the callback, always check document.contains(targetEl). If the target has been removed, call observer.disconnect() and return.
Alternatively, if using a parent observer, check whether the removed nodes include the target and disconnect accordingly.
